basic_info.description: This beautifully updated 3 lvl, 3BDR/2BA Corona Heights view home embodies SF living at its finest. Perfectly situated between the Castro and Cole Valley, just a 10-minute walk to the Castro Muni Metro, world-class parks, cafs, and restaurants! Light-filled open living and dining spaces flow seamlessly, warmed by a brick w/b fireplace and framed by a wall of windows showcasing city and bay views. The modern, pro eat-in kitchen offers more sweeping vistas and opens with sliding glass doors to a sun-drenched deck ideal for entertaining. Outfitted w a Bosch five-burner range and dishwasher, stainless refrigerator, 2022 quartz counters and cabinetry, breakfast area, and abundant storage. Sumptuous primary suite with WIC and tiled en suite BA completes the main level. Down the skylit staircase, 2 add'l BDRs each open w sliding glass doors to a shared view deck, plus a generous family BA with double-sink vanity and large walk-in shower. Enjoy spectacular sunrises, moonlight on the Bay, and fireworks. Lush, terraced backyard w irrigation. 900+ sq ft bonus level w rm for a gym, den, and expansion pot'l. Large garage w interior access. Full home automation, Ecobee thermostat, earthquake retrofitting, tankless WH, fresh paint + flrs, undergrounded wires. You CAN have it all!
